senses.gloss: --eleven of them ruled as kings, (१८ kings- वा। प्।); for three centuries, while the total reign of आभीरस्, Gardabhins, Kankas, Yavanas, तुरुष्कस् and गुरुण्डस् amounted to १०९९ (१००९ वि। प्।) years. Thereafter came the Maunas. भा. XII. 1. ३०-32; Br. III. ७४. १७३-7; वा. ९९. ३६०; Vi. IV. २४. ५३-54.
--Devagandharvas; १६ in number; (२४ वा। प्।) Apsarasas were their younger sisters; had six daughters. Br. III. 7. 1-2; वा. ६९. 1, 4, १०.
